sources.title: unsloth/Kimi-K3.1-Pro · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Post-trained from Kimi K3 with large-scale joint reinforcement learning across hundreds of downstream domains, it is the first model in the K3.1 series. With a 1-million-token context window, Kimi K3.1 Pro delivers substantial improvements in coding, 3D creation, financial research, factual accuracy, and other agentic capabilities.

sources.title: Kimi AI Official Site | K3.1 Pro Launches with Upgraded Coding ...
sources.snippet: Kimi K3.1 Pro is now live. Easily tackle complex coding projects, build 3D models, and conduct in-depth financial research. More powerful agentic capabilities help you complete more complex tasks efficiently.
